raw_block.rationale: Targets the first trigger failure with a narrow §3306(b)(11) classifier that distinguishes noncash agricultural remuneration from wages without disturbing the installed termination-payment helper.

inputs.name: is_agricultural_labor
inputs.question: Was the service for which the current remuneration was paid agricultural labor?

inputs.name: payment_is_cash
inputs.question: Was the current remuneration paid in cash rather than in property or another noncash medium?

skill.intent: Determine whether a proposition that remuneration is wages under §3306(b) is contradicted by the statutory exclusion for agricultural labor paid in a medium other than cash.

outputs.description: The native binary label: Contradiction when §3306(b)(11) excludes the payment, otherwise Entailment.
outputs.name: answer

premises.name: exclude_noncash_agricultural_remuneration

origin.quote: remuneration for agricultural labor paid in any medium other than cash

premises.question: Does §3306(b) exclude agricultural-labor remuneration paid in a medium other than cash?

source_obligations.statement: Check whether the current payment was noncash remuneration for agricultural labor and therefore excluded from wages.

support.text: (A) during the calendar year or the preceding calendar year paid wages of $20,000 or more for agricultural labor, or

(B) on each of some 10 days during the calendar year or during the preceding calendar year, each day being in a different calendar week, employed at least 5 individuals in employment in agricultural labor for some portion of the day.

(i) during the calendar year or the preceding calendar year paid remuneration in cash of $20,000 or more to individuals employed in agricultural labor (including labor performed by an alien referred to in subparagraph (B)), or

(ii) on each of some 10 days during the calendar year or the preceding calendar year, each day being in a different calendar week, employed in agricultural labor (including labor performed by an alien referred to in subparagraph (B)) for some portion of the day (whether or not at the same moment of time) 5 or more individuals; and

(B) such labor is not agricultural labor performed by an individual who is an alien admitted to the United States to perform agricultural labor pursuant to sections 214(c) and 101(a)(15)(H) of the Immigration and Nationality Act.
